name: n4_behavior_diff
description: Compare a behaviour snapshot taken before a deploy (n4_behavior_snapshot) with a second snapshot, or with a live read of the same scope when after is omitted (that needs n4_connect), and list what changed: status_changed (status flags before and after, by name), value_changed (the out value text differs; with tolerance, two values that both read as numbers, a locale decimal comma and a trailing unit allowed, count as equal within it), missing (points gone) and new (points added), each as {count, items, more} with up to limit items, sorted by path; summary counts each and unchanged. When either side was truncated, missing and new are {not_checked: why}, never a zero. notes name a station or scope that differs between the two sides. Read-only.

before.description: Name of the snapshot taken before the change

after.description: Name of a second snapshot; omitted: read the live station now (same scope as before)

tolerance.description: Absolute difference under which two numeric values count as unchanged

max_points.description: Most points of the live read
